The team checks preserved artifacts from the root of the project, without repeating them LLL:

Executable code/The commands are omitted in the documentary copy.

Flag --full-prior Extra checks the old archive and dependencies verify check out seal, freeze-in/the code and five sources used; the complete archive has already been verified upon receipt of the result.

setup, run, audit, seal You need a single command to create artifacts, not a viewing command. You don't recreate an existing catalog. You need a separate copy of the code and a new output directory to reproduce the calculation; the original artifacts are saved.

TRUTH.json It contains parameters and complete synthetic states. blind/ contains only ID and 83 cloaked observations; worker.py Read only this interface and use it 13 recent indexes. outputs/ The four matrices, transformations and metrics of each completed case. logs/ The status and time of all attempts. RESULTS.json Predetermined thresholds, the results of sensitivity testing and the decision on admission to real data. AUDIT.json and METRICS_AUDIT.json - checks of arithmetic and independent calculation of metrics; additional auditors and explanatory documents were created after the protocol was fixed; worker And the criteria didn't change.
